title: Users
description: Everyone who signs in to your dealership, and what they can do.

create.title: Add a user
create.description: They sign in with this email and password, then set up two-step sign-in.
create.password_hint: At least 12 characters. They can change it after signing in.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.description: Change the name or the role. A role change applies on their next request.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.description: {{name}} will be signed out and will not be able to sign in. Their records stay. You can activate them again later.
deactivate.self: You cannot deactivate your own account.

mfa.title: Reset two-step sign-in for {{name}}?
mfa.description: {{name}} will set up an authenticator app again at their next sign-in. Their current app and recovery codes stop working.

error.email_taken: Another account already uses this email.
error.last_admin: A dealership needs at least one active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
error.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
error.invalid_name: Enter a first and a last name.
